onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to Akta
onboarding.welcome.description: Akta tracks your work time automatically, in the background — no more need to remember to start a timer every time you switch tasks.
onboarding.autoTracking.title: Automatic tracking
onboarding.autoTracking.description: As soon as you use your computer, Akta records the apps and windows you use, and detects inactivity breaks so it only counts your actually active time.
onboarding.inactivity.title: Inactivity detection
onboarding.inactivity.description: If you don't move the mouse or switch apps for a while, your session pauses automatically. Watching a video without touching the mouse? Exclude that app (by name or window title keyword) in Settings → Inactivity to avoid false pauses.
onboarding.timeline.title: Timeline & dashboard
onboarding.timeline.description: See your day hour by hour on the Timeline, navigate to previous days, and find your stats — billable time, deep work, breakdown by category — on the Dashboard.
onboarding.sessions.title: Sessions & billing
onboarding.sessions.description: Start a session to mark out a billable task — from the button at the top of the app or the shortcuts Alt+Shift+S (start / pause / resume) and Alt+Shift+X (stop). Then mark each session as billable with one click.
onboarding.focusMode.title: Focus Mode
onboarding.focusMode.description: Start a timed session to block apps that distract you. Choose Simple mode (a single timer) or Chained, Pomodoro-style (several focus sessions separated by breaks, fully configurable). The "Create a work session" option starts a billable session in parallel if none is already running.
onboarding.coaching.title: Coaching & Focus Challenges
onboarding.coaching.description: Akta analyzes your past sessions to suggest an optimal cycle and personalized recommendations (with a button to start them directly). In ADHD mode (Settings → Coaching), you also get challenges, a streak of consecutive days, and milestones to unlock — hover over them to see the details.
onboarding.activities.title: Activities
onboarding.activities.description: Filter your activities by date range, categories, tags, or billing status using the filter pills. The summary to the right of the list shows the Professional / Personal breakdown of your activities as a pie chart.
onboarding.projects.title: Projects & clients
onboarding.projects.description: Create your clients and projects with an hourly rate for each. Link your sessions to a project to automatically get the billable amount for each assignment, and check your budget forecasts at the bottom of the tab.
onboarding.categories.title: Categories & tags
onboarding.categories.description: Organize your activity into categories, with automatic recognition by both application and keyword in the window title (e.g., Crunchyroll in your browser goes to Entertainment, not Web browsing). Also add free-form tags to easily find a specific activity.
onboarding.trayWidget.title: Preview from the notification area
onboarding.trayWidget.description: Click the Akta icon in the notification area (next to the clock) for a quick preview: current session, Focus timer, today's summary — without opening the main window. Pin it to turn it into a permanent floating widget, or double-click the icon to open Akta in full.
onboarding.privacy.title: Your data stays with you
onboarding.privacy.description: No data is ever sent to the cloud: everything stays stored locally on your machine. You can export a backup or sync multiple machines via a simple shared file (Settings → Backup) — deletions are properly accounted for between synced machines.
